description: Answer questions from the owner's Telegram history, and read or send messages in their personal account, through tg. Use for any question their chats could answer, even when it does not say Telegram: who said, advised or sent what, a past message, link, file, price or decision. Also to set up Telegram, find a chat or person, read a conversation or send a message. For a question, start with tg <profile> search conversations "<the question>".

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent gather relevant evidence before concluding?
Did the final report trace conclusions back to observable evidence?
